an5.21:1.1: So vata bhikkhave bhikkhu agāravo appatisso asabhāgavuttiko sabrahmacārīsu abhisamācārikaṃ dhammaṃ paripūressatī ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati,
an5.21:1.2: abhisamācārikaṃ dhammaṃ aparipūretvā sekhaṃ dhammaṃ paripūressatī ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati,
an5.21:1.3: sekhaṃ dhammaṃ aparipūretvā sīlāni paripūressatī ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati,
an5.21:1.4: sīlāni aparipūretvā sammādiṭṭhiṃ paripūressatī ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati,
an5.21:1.5: sammādiṭṭhiṃ aparipūretvā sammāsamādhiṃ paripūressatī ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. 2.
an5.21:2.1: So vata bhikkhave bhikkhu sagāravo sappatisso sabhāgavuttiko sabrahmacārīsu abhisamācārikaṃ dhammaṃ paripūressatī ti ṭhānam etaṃ vijjati,
an5.21:2.2: abhisamācārikaṃ dhammaṃ paripūretvā sekhaṃ dhammaṃ paripūressatī ti ṭhānam etaṃ vijjati,
an5.21:2.3: sekhaṃ dhammaṃ paripūretvā sīlāni paripūressatī ti ṭhānam etaṃ vijjati,
an5.21:2.4: sīlāni paripūretvā sammādiṭṭhiṃ paripūressatī ti ṭhānam etaṃ vijjati,
an5.21:2.5: sammādiṭṭhiṃ paripūretvā sammāsamādhiṃ paripūressatī ti ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatī
